title: The Detention of the band room
author: B. M. Galloway
blurb: Jude Thornbury, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
